subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require an exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream fixture before accepting any recovery that can reclassify assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The reduced stream shape is already handled in current source, while the remaining proposed recovery crosses the tool-execution boundary and needs maintainer intent before automation changes it.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss current-main reproduction proves the remaining failure, then fix only that parser path.

options.title: Sponsor provider-specific recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned vLLM/gpt-oss recovery design before exact repro, but require security review and false-positive tests around text-to-tool promotion.

options.title: Close as covered by current parser
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept the reduced source/test coverage as enough and do not want to support the unproven large-prompt recovery path.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss current-main reproduction proves the remaining failure, then fix only that parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history in the central OpenAI-compatible reasoning/tool-call parser path and merged adjacent reasoning-boundary work.
